fispact_ii.identity: FISPACT-II 5.1 documentation; CB1 public output was 4.0/TENDL-2017

comparison_legs.identical_data: both tools consume the same nuclear-data inputs; pass/fail on tolerances
comparison_legs.product_plus_data: each tool with its standard data; differences reported, never a solver verdict

measurement_class_feeds.hands_on_decomposition: diagnostic only — no practitioner study recorded

consumers: P26 G3 measurements feeding the verdict
no blind measurement partition exists for P26; all benchmark corpora were consumed by earlier phases

draft_targets_under_test.hands_on: 50% median hands-on reduction — no recorded baseline; remains undetermined

measurement_rules.headroom_ratio: comparator_complete_wall_time / actinv_complete_wall_time on the complete campaign; reportable only where equivalent-output holds (identical_data) or as labeled product_plus_data
measurement_rules.tmpdir: disk-backed, target/preflight-tmp inside the bounded scope
measurement_rules.wall_time_scope: complete path: input parse + data load + collapse + solve + requested outputs

product_plus_data.note: no pass bound; differences reported and labeled

eligible_population.generation_rule: cartesian: 10 impurity elements x 10 concentrations x 2 spectra x 5 durations

equivalent_output.attribution: same set of nuclides in top-5 by activity at each cooling time

equivalent_output.note: no executable R2S comparator on this workstation; the leg is predeclared comparator_unavailable and the definition stands for any later lawful comparator run
